description: This file defines a PHP class Erf for computing the error function and related operations within the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine, specifically in the engineering namespace.

classes.name: Erf
classes.description: Class providing methods to compute the error function (ERF) and related functions, including precise evaluation and integration bounds.

methods.name: ERF
methods.description: Main method to compute the error function integrated between bounds, supports scalar and array inputs, follows Excel 2010 behavior.

methods.name: ERFPRECISE
methods.description: Calculates the error function at a given limit, essentially a one-sided ERF evaluation, supports array input.

methods.name: erfValue
methods.description: Computes the ERF value for a single input value using a series expansion and the complementary error function for large arguments.
